subject.title: feat: add i18n support with zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) locale

question: Should ClawHub keep app i18n/zh-CN localization paused, accept a staged core implementation now, or close the request as not planned?
rationale: Current main does not implement the request, but member comments on the related closed PRs say ClawHub is not accepting translation/i18n expansion right now; automation should not choose localization policy.

options.title: Keep localization paused
options.body: Leave this issue open as product backlog/no automated fix until maintainers choose to accept ClawHub translation/i18n expansion.

options.title: Accept staged core i18n
options.body: Invite a fresh staged PR with typed keys, SSR-safe locale source, locale-aware shell/head behavior, parity/fallback tests, UI proof, and translation review.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Close the request if maintainers decide ClawHub will not own app localization for now.

recommendation.title: Keep localization paused
